name: Telegram Bot Gateway
author: jaimegh-es
description: Autonomous Telegram Bot Gateway bridging external chat messages to Sayri with Desktop OTP pairing and whitelist authorization. Comes with the new Sayri xui UI (terminal wizard `sayri-telegram wizard` and browser panel `sayri-telegram serve`), decoupled from the daemon.

ui.sync_instructions:
Set up and control the bot with the new Sayri UI:

  sayri-telegram wizard         # wizard in the terminal (xui)
  sayri-telegram serve          # web panel at http://127.0.0.1:8756
  sayri-telegram status         # daemon, token and PIN status
  sayri-telegram token <TOKEN>  # saves the token in ~/.config/sayri/secrets.json
  sayri-telegram pin --rotate   # rotates the pairing PIN

1. Open @BotFather in Telegram and create your bot (/newbot).
2. Copy the token (format 123456:ABC-DEF...) and save it with `sayri-telegram token <TOKEN>`.
3. Send /start to your bot and /pair <PIN> to pair it.
